messages:
nina_enablement: Heads-up: a training invite batch went to customers marked as 'in_trial' but with healthscore < 0.2. We generally only invite healthy customers.
omar_csops: Oof. Any examples?
nina_enablement: acct-0a3, acct-9f2. Email send log: `[2026-04-11T14:02:12Z] outbound send id=em_998 template=enablement_intro target=acct-0a3`
lucy_data: Quick look: segmentation pipeline `enablement_segment_v3` changed last deploy — a missing join on account_status caused some low-health accounts to be included.
notify-bot: deploybot: service=segmentation version=enablement_segment_v3 deployed by lucy_data at 2026-04-11T13:58:05Z
omar_csops: Can we pause scheduled enablement sends? `/playbook pause scheduled_enablement --reason "segment bug"`
notify-bot: command acknowledged: scheduled_enablement paused by omar_csops at 2026-04-11T14:05:00Z reason=segment bug
lucy_data: I'm rolling a rollback of enablement_segment_v3 to v2 now. Also running a quick query to list affected accounts: `SELECT a.id, h.score FROM accounts a JOIN health_scores h ON a.id=h.account_id WHERE a.segment_version='v3' AND h.score < 0.2;`
nina_enablement: If any emails already sent, we need to know content and prepare follow-up. We avoid sending enablement to low health customers because it confuses metrics.
omar_csops: Agreed. Also add a safeguard in the playbook trigger: require `health_score >= 0.5` for scheduled enables until we confirm segment fix.
lucy_data: Done. Patching playbook trigger in staging, will push to prod after quick smoke.
notify-bot: job queued: rollback enablement_segment_v3 id=job_881 status=running
notify-bot: job update: rollback enablement_segment_v3 id=job_881 status=success runtime=45s
lucy_data: Rollback complete. Affected count: 42 accounts got invites. I'll export the list and drop into the CS Ops folder for outreach.
nina_enablement: Thanks. We'll prep a soft clarification email and avoid follow-ups for 48h. Also adding a test in segmentation CI: assert join on account_status exists.
omar_csops: Postmortem items: 1) playbook guard for health_score, 2) segmentation CI test, 3) deploy checklist note about segment schema changes. Assigning tasks and opening ticket CSOPS-10221. ETA mitigation complete in 1h. :white_check_mark:
